brief: A booking platform for independent physiotherapy clinics. Patients book appointments and pay deposits; clinicians manage calendars, treatment notes and invoices. Calm, trustworthy, accessible for older users.
We run three dental practices. Patients should be able to book check-ups online, see their treatment plans and pay invoices. Dentists need a day view of appointments.
Online shop for a small coffee roaster. Customers browse products, add them to a basket and check out. We ship orders across the UK and collect reviews.
A marketplace where local makers list handmade goods and buyers message sellers before they order. Sellers get payouts every week.
An internal tool for our support team to triage tickets, assign them to agents and track SLAs. Customers email us and the tickets appear automatically.
Gym membership app: members book classes, trainers publish weekly schedules, and the front desk checks people in.
A hair salon wants clients to book stylists online, choose treatments and get text reminders. Stylists see their diary for the day.
A charity donation site where supporters give to campaigns, claim gift aid and sign up as volunteers for events.
Council permit applications: residents apply for parking permits, upload documents and pay the fee. Caseworkers review cases and approve or reject them. Must meet accessibility standards.
A CRM for a recruitment agency. Consultants track candidates through interview stages, log calls and manage client companies and open jobs.
Applicant tracking system: post jobs, receive applications, schedule interviews and send offers to candidates.
An observability dashboard for developers to search logs, watch deployments and manage incidents with on-call teams.
Field service app: dispatchers assign work orders to technicians, technicians see jobs on a map and record visits offline.
Property management portal where tenants pay rent, report maintenance requests and landlords track leases.
Estate agent website: buyers search homes for sale, book viewings and agents follow up on leads.
A hotel booking engine for a boutique hotel: guests choose rooms, see rates by date and reserve stays. Housekeeping gets a board of rooms to clean.
Restaurant table reservations and online ordering for collection. Diners see the menu, reserve tables and order dishes.
Food delivery app connecting restaurants, couriers and hungry customers. Track deliveries live on a map.
Event ticketing for a music festival: attendees buy tickets, organisers check them in at the gate and see sales reports.
Conference app where speakers submit talks, attendees build their schedule and sponsors get leads.
Online course platform: instructors create courses with lessons and quizzes, learners enrol, pay and earn certificates.
School admin system for attendance, timetables and reports. Parents get messages about their children.
Nursery app for parents: staff post daily reports about each child, parents pay invoices and book extra sessions.
A bookkeeping app for freelancers to send invoices, snap receipts, track expenses and prepare VAT returns.
Personal budgeting app: connect bank accounts, categorise transactions, set budgets and savings goals.
Mobile banking app with accounts, card controls, payees and instant transfers. Security is critical.
Crypto portfolio tracker with wallets, price alerts and a trade history.
Insurance self-service: customers buy policies, get quotes and file claims with photos; claims handlers review claims.
Legal practice management: lawyers manage matters, deadlines, client documents and billing.
Agency client portal where clients approve deliverables, see timesheets and pay invoices.
Project management tool with projects, tasks, milestones and comments for remote teams. Kanban board and timeline.
A personal to-do list and notes app with projects, simple and calm.
Warehouse inventory system: track stock levels by location, record stock movements and raise purchase orders to suppliers.
Shipment tracking for a freight forwarder: customers track parcels, carriers update statuses and ops plan routes.
Factory dashboard showing machines, OEE, production batches and quality defects by shift.
Construction site app for snagging: site managers log defects with photos, assign them to subcontractors and run inspections.
Smart home monitoring: devices report sensor readings, users get alerts when something goes wrong.
Compliance platform for SOC 2: map controls, collect evidence, track risks and vulnerabilities.
Survey builder where teams create forms with questions, share them and analyse responses.
Community forum for open source maintainers with threads, groups and moderation reports.
Photo sharing social app: people follow friends, post photos, comment and message each other.
Dating app with profiles, matches, chat and safety reporting.
Esports platform where players join tournaments, track matches and climb leaderboards.
Music streaming app with playlists, albums and artist pages for listeners.
Independent news site with articles, authors, categories and a paid subscription for readers.
A creator membership platform: fans subscribe to tiers, creators publish posts and receive payouts.
A portfolio site for a freelance designer to show case studies and testimonials and receive enquiries.
HR platform: employees request leave, managers approve it, and HR runs performance reviews.
Vet clinic booking: pet owners book appointments for their pets and receive vaccination reminders.
Dog walking marketplace: owners find carers nearby, book walks and pay in the app.
Telehealth service with video consultations, e-prescriptions and secure messaging between patients and doctors.
Energy supplier customer portal for meter readings, tariffs, bills and usage charts.
Farm management app tracking fields, crops and livestock with daily tasks.
Car dealership site: customers browse vehicles, book test drives and request finance quotes.
AI writing assistant where users chat with an assistant, manage prompts and organise documents.
Market intelligence terminal for procurement teams: watchlists, supplier research reports and source documents.
Sales CRM: reps manage deals in a pipeline, log activities against contacts and companies.
Subscription SaaS admin console: workspace members, roles, billing plans and usage reports.
Yoga studio app for booking classes, buying memberships and watching on-demand workouts.
Volunteer coordination tool for a food bank: volunteers sign up for shifts and coordinators track hours.
Caravan park booking site where campers reserve pitches and pay a deposit.
Tool library app: members borrow tools, reserve them in advance and return them to lockers.
Clinical trial management for researchers: enrol participants, schedule visits and record test results.
Boat mooring booking for a marina: boat owners book berths and pay fees online.
Grant application portal: applicants submit grants with documents, reviewers score them and admins publish decisions.
Coworking space app: members book desks and meeting rooms and buy day passes.
Bike rental app: riders find bikes on a map, unlock them and pay per minute.
Recipe and meal planning app where families plan meals, save recipes and build shopping lists.
Garage booking for car servicing and MOT tests, with quotes and service history.
Tutoring marketplace connecting students with tutors for one-to-one lessons, booked and paid online.
Translation agency portal: clients upload documents, get quotes and download translations.
Laboratory sample tracking: technicians register samples, record test results and generate reports.
A wedding venue enquiry and booking site with packages, viewings and deposits.
Physiotherapy home-exercise app: therapists assign exercise plans, patients log workouts and track pain scores.
Church giving and events app for members to donate and RSVP to events.
Fleet maintenance tracker: vehicles, service schedules, defects reported by drivers.
Allotment society app: plot holders pay rent, view waiting lists and swap seeds.
Medical records viewer for GPs with patient timelines, referrals and prescriptions. Dense, technical, keyboard-first.
Ski school booking: parents book lessons for children, instructors see their groups each morning.
Escape room booking with time slots, group sizes and online payment.
Photography studio: clients book shoots, approve photos in a gallery and pay invoices.
Kids activity club: parents register children for camps and workshops and pay online.
Pharmacy click-and-collect: customers order repeat prescriptions and choose a collection time.
Laundry pickup service with orders, delivery slots and courier tracking.
Museum ticketing and membership with timed entry slots.
Analytics for a chain of retail stores: sales by store, stock levels and staff rotas.
An IT service desk for a university: students raise requests, staff approve access and track incidents.
Ride-hailing app for an island community: riders request rides, drivers accept them, everyone sees the route.
Bakery pre-order site: customers order cakes for pickup dates and pay deposits.
Speech therapy practice: therapists keep session notes, families book sessions and download progress reports.
Co-op energy community: members track solar panel output and vote on proposals.
Exhibition stand builder marketplace: exhibitors request quotes from builders and compare them.
Clinic rota app: nurses swap shifts and managers approve them.
A habit tracker that helps people build streaks, simple and playful.
Wine club subscription: members receive monthly boxes, rate wines and manage deliveries.
Court booking for a tennis club: members book courts and pay guest fees.
Driving school: learners book lessons with instructors and track test progress.
Recycling collection app for a council: residents book bulky waste collections and report missed bins.
Freelance invoicing tool with clients, quotes, invoices and payment reminders.
